description: Correct Korean spelling and spacing and return correction blocks.

custom_dict_names.description: Names of custom dictionaries to apply during correction.

disable_caret_spacing.description: When true, disable caret-based spacing correction.

disable_split_sentence.description: When true, do not split the text into sentences.

disable_vx_spacing.description: When true, disable VX spacing correction.

enable_cleanup_whitespace.description: When true, clean up whitespace in the corrected text.

enable_limited_punctuation.description: When true, enable limited punctuation handling.

treat_as_title.description: When true, treat the text as a title.

name: correct_grammar
